items.source: Detects beans that depend on database initialization. Implementations should be registered in META-INF/spring.factories under the key org.springframework.boot.sql.init.dependency.DependsOnDatabaseInitializationDetector.
items.translation: 检测依赖于数据库初始化的 Bean。实现应在 META-INF/spring.factories 下注册，键为 org.springframework.boot.sql.init.dependency.DependsOnDatabaseInitializationDetector。

items.source: Detect beans defined in the given beanFactory that depend on database initialization.
items.translation: 检测在给定beanFactory中定义的依赖于数据库初始化的 Bean。

items.source: Detect beans defined in the given beanFactory that depend on database initialization. If no beans are detected, an empty set is returned.
items.translation: 检测给定 beanFactory` 中依赖于数据库初始化的 Bean。如果没有检测到任何 Bean，则返回一个空集。
beanFactory - 要检查的 Bean 工厂

items.source: names of any beans that depend upon database initialization
items.translation: 任何依赖于数据库初始化的 bean 的名称
